Name: Suki - The Romanceable Traveling Merchant (Custom NPC)
Author: wlyra
Description:
[size=5][b]About Suki[/b][/size]
Everyone in Pelican Town knows the Traveling Cart that shows up in Cindersap Forest, but nobody really knows the woman holding the reins.

[b]Suki The Traveling Merchant[/b] introduces Suki as a fully fleshed-out, romanceable, and marriageable NPC. At first, she is guarded, sharp-tongued, and strictly focused on moving her smuggled Gotoro Empire goods without getting caught. However, as you spend time with her and earn her trust, you'll see the softer side beneath her tough exterior—and maybe even convince her that Pelican Town is worth settling down for.

[size=5][b]Features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Custom Forest Cottage:[/b] Suki has her own house (exterior and interior) located in Cindersap Forest.[/*]
[*][b]Progressive Dialogue:[/b] Dynamic daily dialogues that evolve naturally as your heart level increases—from a suspicious smuggler to a close friend, partner, and loving spouse.[/*]
[*][b]6 Heart Events (2 to 14 Hearts):[/b] A complete story arc covering her life on the road, her struggles with border patrols, her decision to stay in the valley, and a special post-marriage dinner event with the town's couples.[/*]
[*][b]Full Marriage Support:[/b] Includes custom engagement dialogue, wedding attire, a custom Spouse Room, post-marriage schedules, and warm farm-life marriage dialogues.[/*]
[*][b]Festival Integration:[/b] Suki attends town festivals, has unique festival dialogues, participates in the Feast of the Winter Star gift exchange, and can be asked to dance at the Flower Dance.[/*]
[/list]
[size=5][b]Character Info & Schedule[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Birthday:[/b] Summer 15[/*]
[*][b]Residence:[/b] Suki's House in Cindersap Forest[/*]
[*][b]Schedule Note:[/b] Before marriage, Suki wanders around Cindersap Forest, Pelican Town, Marnie's Ranch, Pierre's Shop, and the Saloon on [b]Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, and Saturday[/b]. On [b]Fridays and Sundays[/b], she is busy running her merchant business and won't be found walking around town.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Gift Tastes (Spoilers)[/b][/size]
[spoiler]
[list]
[*][b]Loves:[/b] Triple Shot Espresso, Truffle Oil, Prismatic Shard[/*]
[*][b]Likes:[/b] Wine, Pale Ale, Gold Bar, Iridium Bar, Diamond, Ruby, Emerald, Amethyst, Topaz[/*]
[*][b]Dislikes:[/b] Vegetables, Clay, Sap, Hardwood[/*]
[*][b]Hates:[/b] Joja Cola, Trash, Driftwood, Broken Glasses, Bug Meat, Slime[/*]
[/list][/spoiler]

[size=4][b]Heart Events Guide (Light Spoilers)[/b][/size]
[spoiler]
[list]
[*][b]2 Hearts:[/b] Enter Robin's Carpenter Shop between 9:00 AM and 5:00 PM.[/*]
[*][b]4 Hearts:[/b] After reaching 4 hearts, Suki will send you a letter in the mail. Enter the Secret Woods between 4:00 PM and 11:00 PM on any day except Friday or Sunday.[/*]
[*][b]6 Hearts:[/b] Enter the Stardrop Saloon on a Thursday between 5:00 PM and 10:00 PM.[/*]
[*][b]8 Hearts:[/b] Enter the Beach between 8:00 PM and 12:00 AM (Midnight).[/*]
[*][b]10 Hearts:[/b] Enter Pelican Town between 8:00 PM and 11:00 PM.[/*]
[*][b]14 Hearts:[/b] Requires marriage to Suki, Year 2 or later, and having met Kent. You will receive a dinner invitation letter from Jodi in the mail. Enter Jodi's House (1 Willow Lane) between 6:00 PM and 10:00 PM.[/*]
[/list][/spoiler]

[size=5][b]Requirements & Installation[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of [b]SMAPI[/b].[/*]
[*]Install [b]Content Patcher[/b].[/*]
[*]Download this mod and extract the [b]Suki The Traveling Merchant[/b] folder into your [b]Stardew Valley/Mods[/b] directory.[/*]
[/list]
[size=5][b]Future Plans, Feedback & Transparency[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Active Development:[/b] I plan to continue updating and expanding this mod with new dialogues, events, and features over time.[/*]
[*][b]Feedback & Bug Reports:[/b] If you have any ideas, suggestions for future updates, or if you encounter any bugs/glitches while playing, please don't hesitate to leave a comment or open a bug report! All feedback is super welcome.[/*]
[*][b]AI Disclosure:[/b] AI tools were used for assistance at certain points during the coding and scripting process of this mod.[/*]
[/list]
